SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：Sp. B. No. N 934 27/6/41）

REPORT

S. 1, Special Branch Station File No. Date June 27, 1941.

SUBJECT: Hanza Emile Ezra

Hanza Emile EZRA, nee Teckler, was born at Lomachantzy, Rumania on November 20th, 1899. She first came to Shanghai in 1923, as far as is known and it is believed that she lived with Judah Ezra for some time in Shanghai.

In March, 1931, Judah Ezra, British, went from Shanghai to San Francisco, and was followed in 1933 by Hanza Teckler. They were married at San Francisco on March 9th, 1933. Six days later, on March 15th, 1933, Judah Ezra was arrested by the U.S.A. Federal Narcotic Squad and charged with the illegal importation and sale of narcotics.

Judah Ezra pleaded guilty to the charges and the U.S. Department of Labour ordered the deportation of Judah and Mrs. Ezra. The order re Judah Ezra was to become effective after he had served whatever sentence was imposed upon him. Mrs. Ezra was ordered to leave the U.S.A. immediately. She was, however, granted permission to remain until her husband was sentenced.

On September 23rd, 1933, Judah Ezra was sentenced to 12 years imprisonment and fined U.S. $12,000. Immediately after sentence was passed, Mrs. Ezra stated to newspaper reporters that she would file an action for divorce within 10 days and upon the granting of an interlocutory

（印：特别分部编号 N 934 1941年6月27日）

报告

S. 1，特别分部驻所档案号。日期：1941年6月27日。

主题：Hanza Emile Ezra

Hanza Emile EZRA，婚前姓 Teckler，于1899年11月20日出生于罗马尼亚 Lomachantzy。据所知，她于1923年首次来到上海，且相信她在上海曾与 Judah Ezra 共同生活了一段时间。

1931年3月，英籍人士 Judah Ezra 从上海前往旧金山，Hanza Teckler 随后于1933年追随而去。两人于1933年3月9日在旧金山结婚。六天后，即1933年3月15日，Judah Ezra 被美国联邦麻醉品缉查队逮捕，并被指控非法进口和销售麻醉品。

Judah Ezra 对指控认罪，美国劳工部下令将 Judah 和 Ezra 夫人驱逐出境。关于 Judah Ezra 的命令在其服完判处的刑期后生效。Ezra 夫人被命令立即离开美国。然而，她获准停留至其丈夫被判刑为止。

1933年9月23日，Judah Ezra 被判处12年监禁，并处罚金12,000美元。判决宣判后，Ezra 夫人立即向报社记者表示，她将在10天内提起离婚诉讼，并在获得临时

（批注：E 474）

（印：归档）

On October 26th, 1933, the United Press
at San Francisco quoted Mrs. Ezra as saying,
"I still love him (Judah Ezra) and can't bring
myself to start a divorce action. I will go
to Shanghai and wait for him. Perhaps his
sentence will be reduced when it is realized
that it was very severe and that he will never
engage in the business again. Perhaps we can
start all over again and be happy." Mrs. Ezra
sailed for Shanghai that day on the s.s. "Falstra".
and arrived in Shanghai on November 29th, 1933.
Since 1933 Mrs. Ezra has been employed in
the cosmetics business and also in the embroidery
trade. Until about two months ago she was
employed in the Broadway Mansions Beauty Parlour.
Mrs. Hanza Ezra is a British subject by
marriage to Judah Ezra and she has registered
at the British Consulate annually since 1935.
It is understood that she has been kept
by Sgt. J.K. Vassilieff for some years.
Judah Ezra was released from prison in
June or July, 1940, and he is now in Shanghai,
his address being c/o The China Gold and Yarn
Market, 102 Central Arcade. In a recent interview
with H.B.M's. Passport Officer, Judah Ezra stated

判决令后，将乘船前往上海。
1933年10月26日，合众社
在旧金山引用 Ezra 夫人的话说：
“我仍然爱他（Judah Ezra），无法
强迫自己启动离婚程序。我将去
上海等他。也许当人们意识到
刑罚过重，且他绝不会再从事
此类行当时，他的刑期会减轻。
也许我们可以重新开始，获得
幸福。” Ezra 夫人
当日乘坐“Falstra”号轮船
启程前往上海，并于1933年11月29日抵达上海。
自1933年以来，Ezra 夫人受雇于
化妆品行业，同时也从事刺绣
贸易。直到约两个月前，她
受雇于百老汇大厦美容院。
Hanza Ezra 夫人因与 Judah Ezra 结婚
而成为英国臣民，且自1935年以来
每年在英国领事馆进行登记。
据悉，她多年来一直由
J.K. Vassilieff 警佐供养。
Judah Ezra 于
1940年6月或7月获释出狱，目前他在上海，
地址为中央商场102号中国金线市场转交。
